rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Very steep, narrow tree-lined lane with homes 10-12 m away.
reasons: Narrow lane, no room to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings are 10 m (at 20 m) and 18 m; houses front the lane on both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane under dense canopy, no verge or pull-off wider than a van, overhead wires.
drivers.convention: No parked cars seen in the lane; signs are 2P residents-excepted and a No Stopping sign.

flags: Signs: No Stopping Any Time on part of the lane
Brisbane River 335 m away, elevation 20 m
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy covers most of the lane, shading it all day.

best_section.where: Flattest part near the bottom of the lane, beside the grassed yard
